newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AIRLINE, RAIL FREIGHT Q1 VOLUMES RISE.
newsitem.headline: AIRLINE, RAIL FREIGHT Q1 VOLUMES RISE.

text.p: The cargo carried by Lithuania's railways and airlines rose in the first quarter of 1997, the statistics office said on Tuesday.
The volume of cargo carried by rail increased in the first quarter of 1997 to 7.436 million tonnes, 27.6 percent more than in the same period last year, it said in a statement.
Airline companies carried 491.2 tonnes of freight, luggage and post in the first quarter of 1997, 26.3 percent more compared to the same period last year, it added.
Airline companies carried 45,800 passengers in the first three month of the year, a 6.5 percent increase over the same period last year.
Some 42,700 people were carried on scheduled flights, a 4.3 percent increase on the same period last year.
